name: Order and Delivery
description: Guidelines for resolving order status, shipping delays, tracking updates, and missing or damaged packages.
eligibility_and_rules: Standard delivery timeline is 3-5 business days from order fulfillment.
Express delivery timeline is 1-2 business days.
If a package is marked 'Delivered' but the customer states it was not received, advise checking secure drop areas, mailrooms, and with neighbors before opening a lost parcel claim.
Lost parcel claims can be initiated 24 hours after the delivery status timestamp.
Address changes are only permitted if the order status is 'Processing' and not yet 'Shipped'.
resolution_actions: Check tracking status in internal logistics portal.
If delayed past standard delivery date, issue shipping carrier inquiry.
If lost in transit, offer free replacement or store credit.
auto_reply_guidelines: Acknowledge the delay with empathy, reference the order ID if available, request missing order details if missing, and assure the customer that the logistics team is investigating.

name: Refund
description: Rules for handling product returns, refund eligibility, cancellations, and billing disputes.
eligibility_and_rules: Return requests must be submitted within 30 days of item delivery.
Items must be in original condition, unopened, and in original packaging to qualify for a full refund.
Digital products, downloadable software, and gift cards are non-refundable once accessed or redeemed.
Approved refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Defective or damaged items received by the customer are eligible for a 100% refund or free replacement with shipping fees waived.
required_customer_info: Photos of item condition (for damaged/defective items)
resolution_actions: Verify purchase date and eligibility against the 30-day window.
Generate prepaid return shipping label if eligible.
Trigger refund payout upon receipt and warehouse inspection.
auto_reply_guidelines: Politely acknowledge the refund request, outline the 30-day policy criteria, provide steps to initiate return label generation, and set expectations for the 5-7 business day processing timeline.

name: Technical Support
description: Procedures for resolving website errors, account login failures, payment checkout bugs, and platform downtime.
eligibility_and_rules: Issues blocking checkout or account access are treated as urgent/P1 priority.
Standard troubleshooting steps (browser cache clearing, disabling conflicting browser extensions, trying incognito mode) should be suggested initially.
Security-related issues (unauthorized account access, password reset failures) require immediate identity verification before releasing account changes.
Persistent bugs must be escalated to the engineering on-call team with diagnostic logs and reproduction steps.
required_customer_info: Browser type and version (e.g., Chrome 124, Safari 17)
Device and Operating System (e.g., Windows 11, iOS 18, macOS Sonoma)
Steps taken right before the error occurred
resolution_actions: Review server error logs corresponding to the user session timestamp.
Guide customer through quick cache/cookie clearing steps.
Escalate unresolved bugs to Jira/engineering queue with severity tag.
auto_reply_guidelines: Apologize for the inconvenience, ask for browser/device specifics and screenshots if not already supplied, suggest clearing cookies/cache as a quick test, and confirm engineering review.

name: General Inquiry
description: Handling general questions regarding product availability, store hours, company information, partnerships, and general feedback.
eligibility_and_rules: Provide accurate, friendly information based on current public knowledge base and FAQ documents.
Partnership and vendor inquiries should be routed to business development (partnerships@company.com).
Product restocking questions should reference estimated restock schedules or invite customer to join email waitlists.
Feedback and feature suggestions should be documented and forwarded to the product management feedback board.
resolution_actions: Answer customer question directly using the knowledge base.
Tag inquiry with relevant topic category for trend analysis.
Close ticket once the customer confirms their question was answered.
auto_reply_guidelines: Provide a warm and welcoming response, address the specific question directly, link to the relevant help center article or documentation, and invite follow-up questions.
